items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know Bill. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I heard it.

ctx.x: I never knew it. I know Bill. Yeah, Bill played. He used to play drum too, but he played trombone.

Yeah. Well, you already talk, that fella, Louis Double, Red Allen. Oh, yeah. I played with all them, yeah. George O'Neill. Yeah. George O'Neill, he's not here though. Now, they got an old friend of mine, he used to play violin. He used to play with Sam Morgan and them, but he stopped playing years. I know some of them old fellas too, but he stopped playing years. He's a violin player? He used to play violin, yeah. What is his name? Pete Alexander. Oh, Pete Alexander.
